text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but I should not let that satisfaction alone decide when to sell; assess every holding by its future prospects and portfolio role.","I should not let losses or my average cost anchor me: admitting a purchase was mistaken is less important than making a sound decision from here.","My trades have not shown that recent price moves predict future returns, so I should avoid reacting to them and make deliberate, diversified decisions sized to my risk goals."]}
